purpose: Complete the missing DLinear/NLinear comparison for the current-source MambaTSv3 AutoCon high-dimensional H96 screen before any Electricity/Traffic held-out protocol is considered.
research_question: Does the frozen prediction-connected MambaTSv3 AutoCon candidate remain competitive with DLinear and NLinear on Electricity and Traffic H96 under the same current-source budget?
architecture: The candidate uses one Mamba-1 patch scan and a zero-initialized prediction-connected AutoCon representation residual. AutoCon relation training is enabled only for the candidate; DLinear and NLinear remain plain forecasting baselines.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory matrix. Every job skips the test loader; no test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or test release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: A passing result only completes a same-source H96 baseline screen for Electricity and Traffic. It does not establish held-out accuracy, universal superiority, causal relation-loss benefit, long-horizon performance, or hardware-independent speed.

required_before_launch: verify Electricity and Traffic fingerprints and the complete 18-job expansion
freeze candidate, DLinear, NLinear, optimizer, normalization, and seed contracts
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job
create one immutable source snapshot and fresh output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Candidate architecture, AutoCon lambda, baseline set, data split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, and seeds are fixed before launch; no held-out signal or dataset-specific retuning is permitted.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only MambaTSv3AutoCon receives the frozen AutoCon objective and prediction-connected representation fusion.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: DLinear and NLinear receive no AutoCon, representation-fusion, ACF-memory, or candidate-only Mamba setting.

phases.name: candidate_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Frozen current-source MambaTSv3 AutoCon representation-fusion candidate.

phases.name: linear_baselines_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Same-contract DLinear and NLinear high-dimensional baselines.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report only paired validation deltas from this single source snapshot. DLinear/NLinear speed is measured separately and cannot be inferred from validation wall time.

stopping_rules: Do not promote a dataset to a held-out plan if the candidate is more than 2% worse than its strongest registered baseline.
Do not infer an AutoCon causal contribution from this candidate-versus-baseline matrix; exact mechanism controls are separate evidence.
Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
